title: NUS AI Hackathon 2026
description: 48-hour build sprint on an applied AI theme, judged by a mix of faculty and industry mentors.

title: National Tech Strategy Case Challenge
description: Teams solve a real-world tech-strategy case for a sponsoring company over two weeks.

title: SEA Data Science Open
description: A regional applied-ML leaderboard competition on a healthcare prediction task.

title: NUS Enterprise Pitch Night
organizer: NUS Technology Venture Studio (Prof. Jonathan Teo)
description: 5-minute pitches to a panel of alumni founders and investors, for teams with an early-stage idea.

title: Inter-University Robotics Challenge
description: Teams build and program a robot to complete a warehouse-navigation task under time pressure.

title: Reproducibility Challenge — AI Track
organizer: NUS AI Alignment Lab (Prof. Farid Hassan)
description: Students reproduce a recent AI safety paper's results and write up discrepancies found.

title: Civic Data Challenge
description: Open data challenge on public infrastructure datasets, judged on real-world usefulness of the analysis.

title: Southeast Asian Language Tech Challenge
organizer: NUS Multilingual AI Lab (Prof. Meera Pillai)
description: Build a small NLP tool for an under-resourced Southeast Asian language and present it to a language-tech panel.
